observation.visible_scene: A small home aquarium with pink gravel substrate, containing several orange goldfish, a small pale fish near the top, and a tiny fish in the center. Decorations include a white statue, a red windmill, a cat figure, a clear glass goblet structure, a tall green plant, and a black ribbed filter tube on the right.
visible_changes: The orange fish initially positioned at the top left near the pink filter block descends and moves rightward, eventually entering the bowl of the clear glass goblet structure.
The fish initially near the statue's head on the left swims rightward, ending up hovering near the red windmill decoration.
The large orange fish in the center slowly drifts leftward, moving from a position near the windmill toward the white statue.
A continuous stream of small bubbles rises in the background near the green plant and the clear tubing.
The bottom-left orange fish remains in the lower left corner, making only minor positional adjustments.
The camera remains static throughout the clip.
outside_clip_unknowns: The behavior of the fish before the clip started and after it ended.
The source of the bubbles (whether from an air pump or filter outflow) is not fully visible.
uncertain_details: The exact species of the small pale fish at the top and the tiny fish in the center.
Whether the orange fish inside the glass goblet is truly inside or behind it due to the glass distortion, though it appears to enter the structure.
